questions.question: 다음 짝지어진 단어의 관계가 나머지와 다른 것은?
questions.explanation: ①②④⑤는 명사/형용사에서 형용사로 변형되는 관계이고, ③은 명사에서 동사로 변형되는 관계로 다르다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 ⓐ, ⓑ에 들어갈 말이 차례대로 연결된 것은?
• The word chef originates ⓐ_________ French.
• I pick ⓑ_________ some useful English expressions from books.
questions.explanation: originate from은 '~에서 비롯되다'라는 의미이고, pick up은 '습득하다'라는 의미이다.

options: I met an <u>Iraqi</u> in a conference last year.
There is a Legoland theme park in <u>French</u>.
You can see street notices in both of <u>English</u> and the local language in Scotland.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 알맞은 것을 두 개 고르면?
questions.explanation: ②Iraqi는 이라크 사람을 나타내는 형용사로 쓸 수 있고, ⑤English는 언어를 나타낼 때 올바른 표현이다. ①Israeli는 Israel의 형용사, ③Philippines(복수형)가 맞음, ④France가 맞음.

options: BTS is also really popular in <u>Thai</u> and Japan.
He's not Mexican. He's not American, either. He's <u>Greek</u>.
A <u>Scottish</u> man named Jim Dunbar was working in my school.
<u>Peru</u> is a strong team that stands at 22nd in the FIFA rankings.
Vincent van Gogh is a famous <u>Dutch</u> artist who lived from 1853 to 1890.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: Thai는 타이 요리 같은 명사로 쓸 때 가능하고, 국가 지역을 나타낼 때는 Thailand의 형용사 Thai로는 어색하다. 'Thailand'를 써야 한다.

options: Diego really likes eating the <u>Spanish</u> food, paella.
I'm planning to visit China, so I need to learn <u>Chinese</u>.
The song was recorded in many languages, including <u>France</u>.
It was painted by the <u>Italian</u> artist Leonardo da Vinci.
<u>Divided</u> Germany became reunited twenty five years ago.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③France는 국가명이고, 언어는 French여야 한다. 'including French'가 올바른 표현이다.

options: someone who buys and sells things as a job
a society that is well organized and developed
all of space, including all the stars and planets
to push part of something in order to make it work
someone who is owned by another person and is forced to work for no money
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 단어의 영영풀이로 알맞지 않은 것은? (단, 순서 상관없음)
• Lincoln helped set _________s in the US free.
• We learned about the Mayan _________ at school.
• If you want to turn on the computer, _________ this red button.
• The _________ directly bought goods from producers.
questions.explanation: 빈칸에 들어갈 단어는 slave(종), civilization(문명), press(누르다), merchant(상인)이다. ③은 universe의 설명이고, 빈칸에 들어갈 단어 중 civilization의 정의가 아니다.

questions.question:
다음 영영풀이에 해당하는 단어는?
a type of exercise in which you move your body into various positions to become more fit or to relax your mind
questions.explanation: yoga는 몸을 다양한 자세로 움직여서 신체를 더 건강하게 하거나 마음을 이완시키는 운동이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 짝지어진 단어들의 관계가 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ pursue : pursuit ⓑ satisfy : satisfaction
ⓒ stable : unstable ⓓ appear : disappear
ⓔ original : originally ⓕ anger : angry
questions.explanation: ⓐ pursue(동사) → pursuit(명사), ⓑ satisfy(동사) → satisfaction(명사)는 같은 관계(동사→명사). ⓒ는 반대어, ⓓ는 접두사 관계, ⓔ는 형용사→부사, ⓕ는 명사→형용사.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은? (단, 어법에 맞게 변형 가능)
• You're so small. I think you can _________ _________ that tunnel.
• We're not staying here. We're just _________ _________.
questions.explanation: pass through는 '통과하다'라는 의미로 두 문장에 모두 적용된다. 첫 번째는 '터널을 통과할 수 있다', 두 번째는 '그냥 지나가는 중이다'라는 의미가 된다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• I ___________ my coat from the cleaners.
• I have to ___________ my boss at five.
• Small children ___________ words from people around them.
questions.explanation: pick up은 '얻다, 습득하다'라는 의미로 세 문장에 모두 적용된다. ①회수하다, ②만나다, ③배우다.

questions.question:
다음 중 밑줄 친 표현의 쓰임이 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ She was born and raised in USA, so she is <u>British</u>.
ⓑ Zelda is a market <u>trader</u>, selling fruit and vegetables.
ⓒ Originally it was a bedroom, but we <u>turned it into</u> a study.
ⓓ She <u>passes through</u> languages well, so learning English is easy for her.
ⓔ She is good at selling cars since she has a lot of <u>experiences</u> as a car <u>dealer</u>.
questions.explanation: ⓐ는 USA에서 태어났으면 British는 아니다(어색), ⓑ trader는 맞음, ⓒ turned it into는 맞음, ⓓ passes through는 '통과하다'이지 '능숙하다'가 아님(어색), ⓔ 맞음.

questions.question:
다음 중 영영풀이가 알맞지 않은 것의 개수는?
ⓐ anger: to make someone angry
ⓑ century: a period of 1000 years
ⓒ flood: a lot of water covering an area that is usually dry
ⓓ slice: a thin piece of food that is cut from something larger
ⓔ suggest: to tell someone you think he or she should do something
ⓕ slave: someone who owns another person and forces that person to work without pay
ⓖ produce: to make something especially by using machines
questions.explanation: ⓑ century는 100년이지 1000년이 아니다. ⓕ slave는 '다른 사람에게 소유되고 강제로 일하는 사람'이지 '소유하는 사람'이 아니다. 따라서 2개가 알맞지 않다.

options: I've been trying to <u>contact</u> you all day. (찾다)
He is a tea <u>trader</u>. He buys and sells tea. (상인)
I <u>picked up</u> tips from this book and made the cake. (제안하다)
Many English words about law <u>come from</u> French. (~를 통과하다)
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 표현의 뜻으로 알맞은 것은?
questions.explanation: ②trader의 뜻은 상인(사고팔기를 하는 사람)이 맞다. ①contact는 연락하다, ③nationality는 국적, ④pick up은 습득하다, ⑤come from은 유래하다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 없는 단어는?
• The man works in a(n) __________ that produces televisions.
• A lot of __________ with other cultures can cause a great change in society.
• Greece is the birthplace of Western __________.
• The __________ of Indian massage goes back to over a thousands of years ago.
questions.explanation: ①factory(공장), ②contact(접촉), ④civilization(문명), ⑤origin(기원)은 문맥에 맞지만, ②fiction(소설)은 '문명'을 나타내는 문장에 맞지 않는다.

options: She has a simple and <u>clear</u> writing style. → I was <u>clear</u> to me that she was lying.
Many people and animals died in the <u>flood</u>. → There are fears that the river could <u>flood</u>.
The machine <u>works</u> well in minus 40 degrees temperature. → The Louvre museum has about four hundred thousand <u>works</u> of art.
The most famous <u>place</u> in the city is the Sydney Opera House. → I needed to <u>place</u> a coke can on the table where my brother had pizzas.
I want to give you a nice <u>present</u> in return. → Students in groups will <u>present</u> how they have reached their conclusions to certain questions.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어의 뜻이 같은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
questions.explanation: ①clear는 둘 다 '명확한'이라는 의미로 같다. ②flood는 홍수(명사)와 범람하다(동사)로 다름, ③works는 잘 작동(동사)과 예술작품(명사)으로 다름, ④place는 장소(명사)와 놓다(동사)로 다름, ⑤present는 선물(명사)과 발표하다(동사)로 다름.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
Sunflowers was painted by Van Gogh, ________ is my favorite painter.
questions.explanation: 선행사 Van Gogh를 가리키는 관계대명사가 필요하고, 주어 역할을 하므로 who를 사용한다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
The word shampoo comes from the Hindi word chāmpo, ___________ means "to press."
questions.explanation: 선행사 chāmpo(단어)를 가리키는 관계대명사로 which를 사용한다.

questions.question:
다음 <보기>와 같이 문장을 바꾸어 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
<보기>
That he lost the race was shocking. → __________ was shocking that he lost the race.
questions.explanation: 가주어 It을 사용하여 진주어 that절을 뒤로 옮긴다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 공통으로 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것은?
• It is strange _________ you are waiting for her.
• It is interesting __________ some animals can use tools.
• It is true ___________ he was the first president of the club.
• It is not surprising ___________ she spent all of her money on shopping.
questions.explanation: It ~ that 구문에서 that을 사용하여 가주어-진주어 구조를 만든다.

options: It is unsafe that people believe.
It believes that the bridge is unsafe.
It is believed that people are unsafe.
It is believed that the bridge is unsafe.
It is unsafe that people believe the bridge is.
questions.question:
다음 <보기>의 문장을 같은 의미를 가진 문장으로 알맞게 전환한 것은?
<보기>
People believe that the bridge is unsafe.
questions.explanation: 수동형 It ~ that 구문으로 변환한다. 'It is believed that...'은 '~라고 믿어진다'는 의미가 된다.

options: It was yesterday that Tom came to see me.
Is it true that women live longer than men?
It was thought that two people were injured in the accident.
It's very interesting that elephants have a good memory.
It is really amazing that the little boy can play the piano so well.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 'It-that'의 쓰임이 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ①은 강조 구문(It ~ that)으로 'yesterday'를 강조한 것이고, ②③④⑤는 가주어-진주어 구문(It ~ that)이다.

options: Julia lost her ring, <u>which</u> was very expensive.
The trees flowered so early, <u>which</u> was unusual.
This is Bulgogi, <u>which</u> is a traditional Korean food.
Chris talked about his new job, <u>which</u> he is enjoying very much.
I am reading a book about Paris, <u>which</u> I visited two years ago.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 which에 대한 선행사의 성격이 나머지와 다른 하나는?
questions.explanation: ②는 계속적 용법의 which로 선행사가 문장 전체이지만, 나머지는 계속적 용법이지만 명사를 선행사로 가진다.

options: In the library I met Sujin, <u>who</u> is Jina's sister.
My friend Joe, <u>who</u> is French, likes Gimchi very much.
I've been to Jeju-do, <u>which</u> is the biggest island in Korea.
I will borrow the book from Tom, <u>that</u> has read it many times.
Abraham Lincoln, <u>who</u> freed slaves, was the president of the USA.
questions.question: 다음 밑줄 친 관계대명사의 쓰임이 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 non-defining relative clause(계속적 용법)이므로 that이 아닌 who를 사용해야 한다. 'I will borrow the book from Tom, who has read it many times.'가 올바르다.

options: I will do some research about that bird.
It is Tom's ball that they are playing with.
It was strange that he woke up at that time.
She thanked all the people that helped her a lot.
It is natural that children should love their parents.
questions.question:
다음 중 that의 쓰임이 <보기>와 같은 것을 두 개 고르면?
<보기>
It is not surprising that the world is round.
questions.explanation: ③⑤는 보기와 같은 It ~ that 가주어-진주어 구조이다. ①은 지시대명사, ②는 강조 구문(It ~ that), ④는 관계대명사.

questions.question:
다음 글의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?
Today I read a book about King Sejong. He created Hangeul, (A)____________ is one of the most scientific writing systems in the world. I think (B)____________ he was very creative.
questions.explanation: (A)는 선행사 Hangeul을 가리키는 관계대명사로 which, (B)는 가주어-진주어 구조의 It ~ that에서 that을 사용한다.

questions.question:
다음 빈칸 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 알맞게 연결된 것은?
• This is the girl (A)__________ rescued the cat.
• Andrey Hepburn, (B)__________ they had been waiting for, arrived late.
• I have been to Rome, (C)__________ is the capital of Italy.
questions.explanation: (A)는 주어 역할하는 관계대명사 that, (B)는 목적어 역할하는 whom, (C)는 주어 역할하는 which.

questions.question:
다음 주어진 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 <보기>의 단어를 배열하여 영작할 때, 순서가 세 번째인 단어는?
올림픽 게임은 4년마다 열리는데, 1896년에 처음 개최되었다.
→ The Olympic Games, ______________________________
________________________ in 1896.
<보기>
place / held / were / every / which / first / take / four / years
questions.explanation: 영작: The Olympic Games, which take place every four years, were first held in 1896. 세 번째 단어는 place이다.

(1) He gave me a letter, which was in a yellow envelope. (A)=letter, (B)=was (계속적 용법 which)
(2) He gave me a letter in a yellow envelope which was... (C)=letter (정의적 용법), (D)=was

options: I called my sister, ____________ lives in Paris.
I saw a movie, ____________ won a prize last year.
Jimin got a good grade, ____________ made her mom happy.
I like a book about London, ____________ I visited five years ago.
We saw the latest Harry Potter film, ____________ we really enjoyed.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 which를 쓸 수 없는 것은?
questions.explanation: ①은 non-defining relative clause이므로 who를 사용해야 한다. 나머지는 모두 which를 사용할 수 있다.

options: The wallet <u>which Emily found in the garden</u> belongs to John. : 'which' is the object of the verb 'found' in the relative clause, and it can be omitted.
I read the book <u>that explained how to make films</u>. : The relative clause ― defining ― tells us which book the speaker means.
The boy <u>who stole the bike</u> is at the door. : 'who' is the subject of the verb 'stole' in the relative clause, and it is referring to 'The boy'.
I remember the day <u>when you had a surprise party</u>. : In the relative clause, 'when' can be omitted or changed by 'which'.
We watched the news, <u>which was about a fire last night</u>. : The relative clause ― non defining ― gives us an extra information about 'the news'.
questions.question: 다음 중 밑줄 친 부분에 대한 설명이 올바르지 않은 것은?
questions.explanation: ④는 when을 omit할 수 있지만 which로 변경할 수 없다. 'when'은 시간을 나타내므로 'that'으로만 바꿀 수 있다.

options: I have a sister, that runs a bakery.
He talked about his new job, he is enjoying.
Mike sent me flowers, whom touched my heart.
This is Gimchi, what is a traditional Korean food.
We had some ice cream for dessert, which was unusual.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤가 올바르다. ①은 non-defining이므로 who, ②는 관계대명사 who 필요, ③은 which 필요, ④는 which 필요.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
(A) Rachel, we met yesterday, lives near my house.
(B) Her uncle, whom she is very proud, is a pilot.
(C) Tom suggested that Susan should join the charity.
(D) Many students were late, which made the teacher angry.
(E) This book, which was written by Tim Robinson, will be made into a movie.
questions.explanation: (A)는 non-defining인데 관계대명사가 없다('who'가 필요). (B)는 'be proud of'이므로 'whom'이 아니라 'of whom'이어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ It is amazing that James won the first prize.
ⓑ Ron is my friend, I study with in the same class.
ⓒ I called Justin, who didn't answer the phone.
ⓓ I tried to open the door, which was impossible.
ⓔ It is true which Tom studied math in the library yesterday.
ⓕ He was a famous engineer, that designed the Eiffel Tower.
ⓖ It is believed by many people that Korean people are very diligent.
ⓗ An old lady, who lived next door, gave me some cookies that she made.
questions.explanation: 올바른 것: ⓐ(It ~ that), ⓒ(who), ⓓ(계속적 which), ⓖ(It is believed that), ⓗ(who와 that 올바름). 어색한 것: ⓑ(who 필요), ⓔ(that 필요), ⓕ(who 필요).

options: I have a friend that is very smart.
We went to the library, where was closed.
I bought a computer, which was very expensive.
My friend Linda, who is a chef, lives in London.
This is Kimchi, that is a traditional Korean food.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장을 모두 고르면?
questions.explanation: ②는 'where'가 아니라 'which'를 사용해야 한다. ⑤는 non-defining이므로 'that' 대신 'which'를 사용해야 한다.

options: The new student, whom I met yesterday, were kind.
The movie what we saw was an action movie.
John broke a vase, that was his mom's favorite.
I want to see the Mona Lisa, which Leonardo da Vinci painted it.
He finished his project with his brother, which made his parents feel proud of him.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 알맞은 문장은?
questions.explanation: ⑤가 올바르다. ①은 were 대신 was, ②는 what 대신 that, ③은 non-defining이므로 which, ④는 중복(painted it 제거).

questions.question:
다음 중 어법에 맞게 영작한 사람은?
Justin: I want to introduce you to my friend, I met in middle school.
Ed: My cousin, that lives in Mapo-gu, is a teacher.
Taylor: It's not easy that find someone with so little time.
Ariana: I have a friend named David, who loves taking pictures.
Bruno: It's nice which you are ready to meet somebody. I'll try to find someone nice for you.
questions.explanation: ④Ariana의 문장이 올바르다. Justin(관계대명사 필요), Ed(non-defining이므로 who), Taylor(to find), Bruno(It's nice that).

options: It is getting cold and dark outside.
It was last summer that she visited London.
It is certain that they will attend the meeting.
It was so organized that we could finish it easily.
It was an amazing story that was written by a famous writer.
questions.question:
다음 문장의 밑줄 친 It과 쓰임이 같은 것은?
<u>It is not surprising that the robot can make pizza.</u>
questions.explanation: ③은 가주어-진주어 구조(It ~ that)로 같다. ①은 기상/시간표현, ②는 강조 구문, ④는 결과를 나타내는 구조, ⑤는 패시브.

options: I read about a man who got lost in the woods.
The red backpack which is on the table is mine.
Ken said he finished his homework which was a lie.
He received the package which I sent a week ago.
She bought me a wallet which I wanted to have.
questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③은 'which'가 'he finished his homework'를 가리키므로 계속적 용법이 되어 부자연스럽다. 더 명확하게는 'but it was a lie'로 표현하는 것이 낫다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 알맞은 것끼리 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ He founded the company, that is now producing new furniture.
ⓑ I was reading the news, which was about a fire last night.
ⓒ We watched a TV program about Mr. Clinton, who is very rich.
ⓓ I am reading a book about Paris, which I visited five years ago.
ⓔ Ann, which is my friend from high school, went to China to study.
questions.explanation: 올바른 것: ⓑ(계속적 which), ⓒ(who), ⓓ(관계대명사). 어색한 것: ⓐ(non-defining이므로 which), ⓔ(Ann은 사람이므로 who).

questions.answer: I lied to my mom, which made her angry.
questions.question:
다음 <예시>를 참고하여 주어진 문장을 관계대명사를 사용하여 바꾸어 쓰시오.
<예시> We went to the zoo, but it was closed. → We went to the zoo, which was closed.
I lied to my mom, and it made her angry. ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: and it made를 계속적 용법의 which which made로 바꾼다.

questions.answer: It is interesting that some animals can use tools.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 같은 의미의 한 문장으로 바꾸어 쓰시오.
That some animals can use tools is interesting.
<조건>
• 가주어 It을 사용할 것
• 주어진 문장의 단어를 모두 사용할 것 ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 가주어 It을 사용하여 진주어 that절을 뒤로 옮긴다.

questions.answer: It is said that you lose your appetite when you are sick.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 주어진 <조건>에 알맞게 영작하시오.
아플 땐 식욕을 잃는다고들 하지요.
<조건>
• 가주어 It으로 시작할 것
• <보기>에 주어진 단어 및 표현을 사용하되 필요시 변형할 것
• 총 12단어로 쓸 것
<보기>
you, your appetite, say, lose, sick ※ 완전한 문장으로 쓰시오.
questions.explanation: 가주어 It, 수동형 is said를 사용하고, 12단어로 구성한다: It(1) is(2) said(3) that(4) you(5) lose(6) your(7) appetite(8) when(9) you(10) are(11) sick(12).
